title: Expose a public observed delivery milestone details builder
summary: Expose the existing schema-bound native delivery-milestone details wrapper so consumers do not import the private domain helper. Building details grants no permission or observed outcome.
in_scope: Add a public keyword-only builder over the existing attention-delivery-milestone schema; return detached validated details with the exact existing descriptor.
Document the helper and retain the existing milestone admission checks; it must not synthesize native assessment authority from study captures.
out_of_scope: Frozen monitoring 1.0/1.1 wire changes, provider calls or qualification, StateCivics implementation and deployment.
implementation: Add a public keyword-only builder over the existing attention-delivery-milestone schema; return detached validated details with the exact existing descriptor.
Document the helper and retain the existing milestone admission checks; it must not synthesize native assessment authority from study captures.

acceptance.criterion: Consumers can build the same native milestone details through a public API.
acceptance.verification: Compare output against the existing descriptor/wrapper using explicit native decision, assessment, subject, audience, purpose, material and delivery-time values.

acceptance.criterion: Invalid values and study output cannot gain native authority.
acceptance.verification: Reject null/non-native assessment shapes, invalid time/material; existing native admission must still reject a forged/study baseline.

acceptance.criterion: The public helper does not mutate caller values or store anything.
acceptance.verification: Mutate the returned mapping and verify inputs are detached; installed import check exposes the builder without private imports.

tests: Compare output against the existing descriptor/wrapper using explicit native decision, assessment, subject, audience, purpose, material and delivery-time values.
Reject null/non-native assessment shapes, invalid time/material; existing native admission must still reject a forged/study baseline.
Mutate the returned mapping and verify inputs are detached; installed import check exposes the builder without private imports.
risks: Structural validity does not confer freshness, authority, integrity or delivery success.

reuse.application: Reuse existing validators and native milestone consumer; no replacement storage or admission engine.
